notes:
aurora_lint 1504 (v0.5.3 step 3), valkey EXP19-C stratum S2, batch 9: a baseline, not a delta (valkey had no EXP19-C labels before S1). Stacked on delta-1504-valkey-exp19c-s2-b08; this branch adds only this batch's rows over its parent.

SCOPE. S2 is every in-scope valkey EXP19-C key at realworld run 274 that is not else-shaped and has no preprocessor directive within the next 5 lines (6,395 keys; S1's 154 are merged). Brandon ruled that S2 is labeled by hand rather than by a mechanical checker. Batches run alphabetically by file, about 130 keys each. This batch: 108 keys in 6 file(s), src/config.c .. src/crccombine.c (if 98, for 7, while 3).

STANDARD. The existing EXP19-C convention (~39,700 labels): TP when the body of the if/for/while/do at that line is a single statement not enclosed in braces (a macro call, return, goto, assignment, empty statement or nested unbraced if all count); FP only when the premise is false and the body is a braced block the tool misread.

METHOD. One read-only agent read every key's construct at source in the pinned checkout and judged it; no script decided a verdict. The adjudicator then checked that each reason's named body token is present at the key and spot-read a random sample at source.

RESULT: 108 TP / 0 FP.

Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision/recall claim is made here.
